sources.title: SANJAY-A-18/PLANT-DISEASE-DETECTION-MODEL - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a deep learning-based image classifier that identifies plant diseases from leaf images. It uses EfficientNetB0 as the backbone and is trained on an augmented dataset using transfer learning, mixed precision, and checkpointing to ensure high accuracy and optimized training time.
